claims.name: ABSORPTION-CEILING
claims.text: For fixed valid endpoints F,Q differing only in jointly U-closed S, anchored total optimized cost of Q is nonincreasing as more exterior phase variables are absorbed, and at full absorption equals mu(Q). If mu(Q)>=mu(F), absorption alone never improves at an old optimal phase of F. The same holds for the whole fixed endpoint family E_S.

claims.name: SIGNED-SEPARATOR-PRICE
claims.text: For an exterior phase system optimized under one prescribed two-port parity, the opposite-parity minimum minus that minimum equals the minimum signed satisfied-minus-violated cut separating the ports. Positive price forces a satisfied connecting path, but its length does not determine the price.

claims.name: MINIMUM-HULL-CHAIN-FAILURE
claims.text: The frozen connected simple cubic eight-vertex frame has a unique self core, two shortest one-row satisfied core-incident chains, and a unique least-cardinality chain hull T. The complete10/16 endpoint families on core hull S/absorbed hull T all have mu>=1; T already contains every old U component. It is not an exterior-only path between two distinct ports and not a positive global frame minimum.

claims.name: JOINT-REPAIR
claims.text: All connected one-edge enlargements of T are classified. Minimum successful cardinality among supports containing T is7. A two-edge topology-changing joint exchange on such a support gives mu1 to0; both single-entry intermediates are invalid. The alternate shortest chain has larger hull8 and succeeds.

claims.name: SMALLER-ORDER-COVERAGE
claims.text: All full preframe A-name orbits and B phases on K4,K33,prism are checked. Every actual self-core occurrence at every attaining phase has a pointed improving endpoint in its bare hull. Therefore order8 is minimal only for this declared self-core/minimum-hull/core-incident family.

first_open_lemma: GLOBAL-EXCHANGE at a hypothetical positive global frame optimum, in particular a genuine distinct-two-port exterior-chain exchange with gain exceeding all new geometric costs.
not_claimed: A bound on global improving support size
root: Every finite simple subcubic graph has a proper edge coloring using at most six colors without bichromatic ordinary four-edge paths or four-cycles.
